capabilities: Promote tags to concept notes by adding tag aliases
Manage tag_links frontmatter properties automatically on tagged notes
Match tags case-insensitively across nested subtags to the deepest concept note
Exclude tags or folders from linking
extras: Requires Obsidian 1.4.4 or later; works on desktop and mobile. Reads every Markdown note in the vault and makes no network requests; the manifest notes it has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
intentEvidence: An Obsidian plugin that links tags to notes. Tags by default, then "Promote" to a note
motivation: The author wanted the best of both worlds: seeing every referral to a concept spanning the note, the tag, and its subtags.
problem: Tags have hierarchy but are not linkable, while notes are linkable but lose tag hierarchy, so referrals to one concept are split between both.
summary: Tag-linking plugin that connects tags to concept notes by managing a tag_links frontmatter property across the vault.
